import subprocess
import sys
import numpy as np

# Scenario 1: pytest cvxpy/tests/test_conic_solvers.py -k copt_exp_soc_1
try:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", 
         "cvxpy/tests/test_conic_solvers.py", 
         "-k", "copt_exp_soc_1", 
         "-v"],
        cwd="/workspace/buggy",
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120
    )
    probe("pytest cvxpy/tests/test_conic_solvers.py -k copt_exp_soc_1 -> StandardTestMixedCPs.test_exp_soc_1(solver='COPT') with no tolerance kwargs (default tolerances)", 
          result.returncode)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("pytest cvxpy/tests/test_conic_solvers.py -k copt_exp_soc_1 -> StandardTestMixedCPs.test_exp_soc_1(solver='COPT') with no tolerance kwargs (default tolerances)", e)

# Scenario 2: check_gradient with x=None on logistic case
try:
    from cvxpy.tests.test_derivatives import TestNLPDeriv
    test_instance = TestNLPDeriv()
    # Find the logistic test case
    if hasattr(test_instance, 'x0'):
        x0 = test_instance.x0
    result = test_instance.check_gradient(x=None, epsilon=1e-8)
    probe("check_gradient(x=None, epsilon=1e-8) on an NLP derivative test, x defaulting to self.x0 with a large objective value (logistic case)", 
          result)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("check_gradient(x=None, epsilon=1e-8) on an NLP derivative test, x defaulting to self.x0 with a large objective value (logistic case)", e)

# Scenario 3: eval_hessian_vals_coo_lower_tri after previous forward pass at different point
try:
    from cvxpy.tests.test_derivatives import TestNLPDeriv
    test_instance = TestNLPDeriv()
    
    # Set up initial point
    x_initial = test_instance.x0 if hasattr(test_instance, 'x0') else None
    
    # First forward pass at initial point
    if x_initial is not None:
        test_instance.objective_forward(x_initial)
    
    # Second forward pass at different point
    x_different = x_initial * 0.5 if x_initial is not None else None
    if x_different is not None:
        test_instance.objective_forward(x_different)
    
    # Call eval_hessian_vals_coo_lower_tri
    hessian_result = test_instance.eval_hessian_vals_coo_lower_tri()
    probe("eval_hessian_vals_coo_lower_tri called after a previous forward pass at a different point (no objective_forward(x)/constraint_forward(x) pinning)", 
          hessian_result)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("eval_hessian_vals_coo_lower_tri called after a previous forward pass at a different point (no objective_forward(x)/constraint_forward(x) pinning)", e)
